meta.name: user-personas
meta.description: Create refined user personas from research data — 3 personas with JTBD, pains, gains, and unexpected insights. Use when building personas from survey data, creating user profiles from research, or segmenting users for product decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从调研数据提炼用户画像与洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从调研数据提炼用户画像来指导产品方向
copy.tagline_en: Extract user personas and insights from research data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to distill user personas from research data to guide product direction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的研究数据（如问卷、访谈记录等）自动生成 3 个用户画像，每个画像包含：任务目标、痛点、期望收益和一个反直觉洞察。
howto.when: 当你上传用户调研数据（如 CSV、Excel、访谈记录），并要求创建用户画像时触发。

say.text: 根据这份用户调研数据，帮我生成 3 个用户画像。
say.note: Claude 会分析数据并输出完整画像。

say.text: 从这些访谈记录中提炼出用户画像，包含任务和痛点。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键模式并生成画像。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will automatically generate 3 user personas from your research data (e.g., surveys, interview transcripts), each including: job-to-be-done, pain points, desired gains, and one unexpected insight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload research data (CSV, Excel, interview transcripts) and ask to create user personas.

say_en.text: Generate 3 user personas from this survey data.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the data and output complete personas.

say_en.text: Extract user personas from these interview transcripts, including jobs and pains.
say_en.note: Claude will identify patterns and generate personas.
